architecturalHypothesis: Tax-shaped substrings inside ordinary words (taxonomies, taxicab, syntax) and tax-shaped procedural nouns in plainly non-tax settings (computer file import, project-management due date, insurance claim file, school labor-day filing) are lexical accidents and cannot anchor a tax relation. Extended the substantive-context vocabulary so a tax acronym paired with a tax-domain noun (FAN response, PAN reply, FLD assessment, BIR audit defense) counts as resolved context rather than a bare materially ambiguous acronym.
